newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-PSV ESCAPE WITH POINT DESPITE LOSING 'KEEPER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PSV ESCAPE WITH POINT DESPITE LOSING 'KEEPER.

text.p: Dutch title challengers PSV Eindhoven escaped with a 1-1 draw at Fortuna Sittard on Friday despite having their goalkeeper sent off in the first half hour.

Ronald Waterreus was dismissed in the 26th minute after handling the ball outside his penalty area. He was replaced by 33-year-old Jan-Willem van Ede, making his debut for PSV after chalking up 409 first division appearances for Utrecht.
Waterreus will miss next week's vital home clash against league leaders Feyenoord Rotterdam.
Fortuna seemed more intent on keeping a clean sheet than winning the game, even with their extra man, they played cautiously throughout the first half.
But after the interval coach Pim Verbeek pushed his men forward and in the 79th minute they won a penalty when PSV skipper Arthur Numan handled inside the box.
Robert Van der Weert successfully converted the spot kick for his first goal since returning from a serious knee injury which kept him sidelined for over a year.

PSV, who meet Norway's Brann Bergen in the Cup Winners' Cup next week, looked to be beaten but five minutes from time Yugoslav midfielder Zeljko Petrovic finished one of his side's few chances with a right foot strike from the edge of the area.
After 10 matches PSV remain second in the table with 21 points, one point behind Feyenoord, who have a game in hand.
